'''Varless''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His unit was tasked with securing the [[Lower Wilds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], though his subordinate [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Cote]] feared they would be overtaken by madness like the previous [[Squad/Legends|squads]] sent into the tombs.<ref name="TOR" />
